asset.name: Export Gas Compressor
asset.type: Centrifugal compressor (motor-driven, VSD), dry gas seals, tilting-pad bearings

hypotheses.name: Rotor imbalance (deposit build-up or loss of material)
Lube oil cooler fouling / high oil temperature

diagnosis.name: Journal bearing wear (DE)
likely_causes: Lube oil contamination or degraded oil (particles, water, varnish)
Insufficient oil film from low supply pressure or high oil temperature
Repeated start/stop or slow-roll operation wiping the babbitt

similar_work_orders.long_text: DE journal bearing vibration trending up, bearing temp high. Bearing replaced, babbitt wiped, oil sample showed high particle count.
Radial bearing DE found worn on inspection, clearance above OEM limit. New pads fitted. Lube oil changed.
Vibration alarm DE probes. Shaft centreline shift. Bearing pads scored - replaced. Recommend oil cleanliness review.
Dry gas seal leakage NDE, faces damaged by liquids in seal gas. Seal replaced, heater repaired.
Alignment correction after baseplate settlement. Soft foot found at NDE motor foot.
